units.source_text: 老人想了想，指着洒在路面上的暮光余晖，说：“这样吧，

en.t: The old man thought for a moment, pointed to the twilight afterglow spilling across the road, and said, "Let us do this,
I will teach you a good way.

units.source_text: 你站在暮光之下，观察映在地上的影子，

en.t: Stand beneath the twilight and watch the shadow cast on the ground,

units.source_text: 夜半时分你挖开你的脑袋所在的方位的地面，

en.t: at midnight, dig open the ground in the direction where your head points,

units.source_text: 那个地方埋着一车黄金。”

en.t: and a cartload of gold is buried there."
